blocks.text: (UPDATED AS OF 12:32 P.M.) MANILA, Philippines — Mayon Volcano recorded a moderately explosive eruption on Friday, Oct. 30, sending a grayish ash plume 3,000 meters above the volcano, the state volcanology agency said. The eruption began at 11:53 a.m. and ended at 11:59 a.m., lasting nearly six minutes, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). Phivolcs said the ash plume was initially measured at 3,000 meters above the volcano and drifted west-southwest.
